title: Covariance of adjusted contrasts from a multi-arm trial
question: When a three-arm trial's population-adjusted contrasts share an arm and a weight vector, what is lost by treating them as independent, is the error ever anticonservative, and is dropping the trial cheaper?
design: Three-arm individual-data trial weighted to a target, plus two aggregate trials in the target; 30 cells crossing effect modification, its alignment across arms, target shift and shared-arm size; split, weights-fixed, stacked and drop analyses. 1000 replicates per cell.
